explanation: `name` is a required parameter. Either make it optional (`name?: string`), give it a default (`name: string = 'world'`), or pass an argument at the call site.

choices.text: Missing 'error' case - function can return undefined

explanation: With `noImplicitReturns` (or strict), TS flags the missing branch. Handle `'error'` or add `default` with an exhaustiveness check (`_never: never = s`).

explanation: TypeScript types are erased at runtime. Trusting external JSON without validation can put any shape into `user`. Validate with Zod or a similar schema library.
